verdict.rationale: Keycloak is fully self-hostable via Docker/container images, Kubernetes Operator, or bare distribution, with explicit guidance to run it on your own production database (e.g., PostgreSQL) rather than a vendor-managed store, giving security engineers full control over deployment location and data residency. Community reports corroborate long-running, stable self-hosted production deployments for years. Missing for 10: independent third-party audit of data residency/isolation guarantees, and more detail on air-gapped/offline deployment support beyond container/operator docs.
